note: A cohort study of 50 novel individuals with SCAF4 variants directly confirmed cognitive phenotypes ranging from normal IQ to severe intellectual disability.

evidence.text: In a study of 50 novel individuals with SCAF4 variants, cognitive abilities ranged from normal IQ to severe intellectual disability, with borderline to mild intellectual disability in the majority of individuals.

source.title: Further delineation of the SCAF4-associated neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: Cognitive abilities ranged from normal IQ to severe intellectual disability (ID), with borderline to mild ID in the majority of individuals.

evidence.text: The discovery study described nine likely pathogenic germline variants where affected individuals were characterized by mild intellectual disability and neurodevelopmental delay.

source.title: Variants in SCAF4 cause a neurodevelopmental disorder and are associated with impaired mRNA processing
source.quote: Affected individuals demonstrated a variable neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by mild intellectual disability, seizures, behavioral abnormalities, and various skeletal and structural anomalies.
